threads.title: Finding Ore Deposits
threads.rule: Surface signs identify underground ore deposits. Read the sign, then look below for ore from the same deposit family.
threads.action: Follow the surface sign and mine ore from the matching deposit.

threads.title: Player Traces
threads.rule: Player traces record movement and work. Return to a place you have visited to inspect the traces left there.
threads.action: Leave the area, then return and inspect its traces.

threads.title: Seasonal Farming
threads.rule: Seasons affect crop fertility. Check the current season and grow crops that are fertile during it.
threads.action: Harvest a crop that is fertile this season.

threads.title: Replanting Trees
threads.rule: Replant after cutting down a mature tree. Use a compatible sapling near the stump to replace the tree you removed.
threads.action: Plant a compatible sapling near the stump.

threads.title: Finding Settlements
threads.rule: Roads lead through the wilderness to settlements. Follow a road to find a settlement.
threads.action: Follow a road into a settlement.

threads.title: Exploring the Nether
threads.rule: The Nether has different resources and hazards from the Overworld. Bring supplies and plan how you will return before exploring.
threads.action: Explore the Nether with supplies and a return route.

threads.title: Exploring the Aether
threads.rule: The Aether is a separate dimension with its own terrain and resources. Prepare supplies and a return route before exploring.
threads.action: Explore the Aether and return safely.

threads.title: Exploring the Bumblezone
threads.rule: The Bumblezone has its own resources and plants. Collect useful materials and keep track of your return route.
threads.action: Collect useful materials in the Bumblezone and return.

threads.title: Exploring Ratlantis
threads.rule: Ratlantis contains dangerous ruins, machinery, and transport routes. Bring supplies and plan your return before exploring.
threads.action: Explore Ratlantis with enough supplies to return safely.

threads.title: Storm Shelter
threads.rule: Storms move through the world. Reach shelter and stay protected until the storm has passed.
threads.action: Stay in shelter while the storm passes.

threads.title: Body Temperature
threads.rule: Body temperature differs from the surrounding temperature. Use clothing and shelter to keep your body within a safe range.
threads.action: Use clothing or shelter to restore a safe body temperature.

threads.title: Safe Drinking Water
threads.rule: Water at purity level 3 is safe to drink. Lower purity can cause illness. Cold Sweat waterskins change temperature but do not restore thirst.
threads.action: Purify water to level 3 before drinking it.

threads.title: Preparing Food for Travel
threads.rule: Hunger and nutrition are separate. Eat foods that replenish your nutrition before entering another dimension.
threads.action: Eat a balanced meal before traveling.

threads.title: Repairing Tinkers Tools
threads.rule: Tinkers tools can be repaired after use. Repair your damaged tool instead of replacing it.
threads.action: Repair a Tinkers tool damaged through use.

threads.title: Making Alloys
threads.rule: Alloying requires the right fluids, proportions, and temperature in a working smeltery. Cast the resulting alloy into the material you need.
threads.action: Make an alloy in the smeltery and cast it.

threads.title: Hand Crank Power
threads.rule: The Hand Crank provides manual rotational power for Create machines. It is your only source of rotational power before the Nether.
threads.action: Use the Hand Crank to run a Create machine.

threads.title: Water Wheel Power
threads.rule: Create water wheels provide renewable rotational power. Connect a wheel to a machine to use that power.
threads.action: Connect a water wheel and run a machine.

threads.title: Making Precision Mechanisms
threads.rule: Precision Mechanisms use Create sequenced assembly. Follow the recipe's steps in order and repeat the sequence as shown in EMI.
threads.action: Follow the Precision Mechanism recipe in EMI.

threads.title: Cooling Heat Networks
threads.rule: A heat network needs a way to remove excess heat. Connect a heat sink and check that the network cools.
threads.action: Connect a heat sink and cool the network.

threads.title: Pressure Chamber Recipes
threads.rule: The Pressure Chamber needs a complete enclosure and enough pressure for its recipe. Check both before processing items.
threads.action: Check the chamber and pressure, then complete a recipe.

threads.title: Processing Ore
threads.rule: Ore families use different separation processes. Look up your crushed ore in EMI and follow the steps for the concentrate you need.
threads.action: Look up the separation steps for your crushed ore.

threads.title: Powering Machines
threads.rule: A generator supplies machines through a connected wire network. Check that the machine receives power.
threads.action: Connect a generator to a machine and check its power.

threads.title: AE2 Autocrafting
threads.rule: AE2 uses encoded patterns to automate crafting. Configure the network, encode a pattern, and request the item.
threads.action: Encode an AE2 pattern and request its output.

threads.title: Scheduled Train Travel
threads.rule: Create trains use stations and schedules for planned trips. Set up stations and a schedule, then ride the train between them.
threads.action: Ride a scheduled train between stations at least 128 blocks apart.

threads.title: Piloting Ships
threads.rule: An assembled ship can move across the world. Pilot the ship and choose a safe place to land.
threads.action: Pilot your ship at least 128 blocks and land safely.

threads.title: Reaching Orbit
threads.rule: A rocket needs a valid destination, enough thrust, and enough delta-v. Check the rocket controls before launching to Earth orbit.
threads.action: Use the rocket controls to prepare a launch to Earth orbit.

threads.title: Spending Life Points
threads.rule: Life points improve your stats when you spend them. Open the stats screen to review the effects before applying your choices.
threads.action: Open the stats screen and spend an available Life point.

threads.title: Using the Blood Altar
threads.rule: The Blood Altar uses Life Essence to process items. Supply the altar and insert an item with an altar recipe.
threads.action: Supply Life Essence and complete an altar recipe.

threads.title: Using Soul Resources
threads.rule: Malum and Goety use soul resources for their operations. Collect the resource needed by the system you are using.
threads.action: Use a soul resource in a Malum or Goety operation.

threads.title: Occultism Rituals
threads.rule: An Occultism ritual needs the correct layout and offerings. Follow its instructions and wait for the ritual to finish.
threads.action: Complete a ritual using the required layout and offerings.

threads.title: Writing Ars Spells
threads.rule: Ars Nouveau spells apply glyphs in order. Write a spell and cast it on a target where its effects can work.
threads.action: Write a spell and test it on a suitable target.

threads.title: Elemental Spell Effects
threads.rule: Elemental modifiers change how an Ars spell affects its target. Test the modified spell on a suitable target.
threads.action: Test an elemental spell where its effect can work.

threads.title: Dimensional Font Travel
threads.rule: Dimensional Fonts provide return trips to other dimensions. Keep track of your Font journey and how to return.
threads.action: Return from your Dimensional Font trip.

threads.title: Keeping Chunks Loaded
threads.rule: A chunk anchor keeps nearby chunks running while you are away. Supply the resource required by that anchor.
threads.action: Supply the anchor and check your machines after leaving the area.

threads.title: Connecting Magic Systems
threads.rule: Ars Creo connects Ars Nouveau to Create machines. Check EMI for available machines and their requirements.
threads.action: Check EMI for Ars Creo machines and their requirements.

threads.title: Developing Relics
threads.rule: A relic gains experience through use. Keep using the same item in situations where its abilities work.
threads.action: Use the same relic again where it can gain experience.

threads.title: Using Source for Machinery
threads.rule: Source Chunk Anchors and Rail Beetle Source Impellers use Ars Source. Ars Energistique conversion is disabled in Better Content.
threads.action: Check the Source requirements of your anchor or engine.

threads.title: Using Enchantments
threads.rule: Enchantments work under specific conditions. Check the enchantment's effect and use the item where that effect applies.
threads.action: Use an enchanted item where its effect applies.

threads.title: Temporary Protection
threads.rule: Temporary protections help with specific hazards. Choose a protection that matches the danger you face.
threads.action: Use a temporary protection suited to the hazard.

threads.title: Downing and Revival
threads.rule: When you are downed, another player can revive you before you bleed out. Death ends the revival opportunity and resets your Life stats.
threads.action: Wait for help and follow the revival controls on screen.

threads.title: Exploring Ruins
threads.rule: Ruins contain resources and threats. Explore carefully and return with supplies before starting another expedition.
threads.action: Leave the ruin alive with an item you found inside.

threads.title: Hostile Faction Combat
threads.rule: Different hostile factions can fight each other. Position yourself so an attack from one faction hits another.
threads.action: Position one hostile faction to hit another.

threads.title: Saving Builds as Schematics
threads.rule: Publish a schematic to preserve a build's design across world resets. The schematic stores the design, not the blocks needed to build it.
threads.action: Publish your build to the lineage schematic library.

threads.title: Preparing for Pillager Assaults
threads.rule: Pillager assaults are announced before arrival. Use the warning to gather allies, prepare defenses, or reach shelter.
threads.action: Prepare shelter and defenses when an assault is announced.

threads.title: Resetting the World
threads.rule: The World Condenser starts a permanent world reset. Review its interface and save what can carry over before committing.
threads.action: Commit only when you intend to reset the world.

threads.title: Sleep and Permanent Spawn
threads.rule: Sleep speeds up the world simulation. Machines, weather, and threats continue during sleep. Beds do not change your permanent spawn point.
threads.action: Check your machines and surroundings before sleeping.

threads.title: Hunger and Nutrition
threads.rule: A full hunger bar does not mean all your nutrition groups are filled. Check the nutrition screen and eat foods for your lowest groups.
threads.action: Eat foods that replenish your lowest nutrition groups.

threads.title: Food Temperature
threads.rule: Food retains its temperature state in storage and when stacks merge. Check the tooltip and thaw frozen food before eating.
threads.action: Check food temperature before eating or using it.

threads.title: Trading with Spirits
threads.rule: Player-credited kills release trading spirits. Each village market accepts its matching spirit color. Eldritch and umbral spirits cannot be used for trade.
threads.action: Collect a trading spirit and spend it at a matching market.

threads.title: The End Is Unavailable
threads.rule: The vanilla End route is disabled. Use Dimensional Fonts for the available dimension trips.
threads.action: Use a Dimensional Font for a return trip.

threads.title: Checking Recipes
threads.rule: Recipes can differ from vanilla and other modpacks. Check EMI for the ingredients and process before gathering materials.
threads.action: Check an item's recipe in EMI before gathering materials.

threads.title: Movement Controls
threads.rule: Fast running, vaulting, and dodging use separate controls and spend stamina. The Movement lesson shows your current key bindings.
threads.action: Practice vaulting and dodging away from danger.
